returns._0: poolKey the pool key of the position
returns._1: CLPositionInfo a uint256 packed value holding information about the position including the range (tickLower, tickUpper)

getPositionLiquidity(uint256).details: this value can be processed as an amount0 and amount1 by using the LiquidityAmounts library

returns.liquidity: the position's liquidity, as a liquidityAmount

initializePool((address,address,address,.details: If the pool is already initialized, this function will not revert and just return type(int24).max

params.key: the PoolKey of the pool to initialize
params.sqrtPriceX96: the initial sqrtPriceX96 of the pool

returns._0: tick The current tick of the pool

modifyLiquidities(bytes,uint256).details: This is the standard entrypoint for the PositionManager

params.deadline: is the deadline for the batched actions to be executed
params.payload: is an encoding of actions, and parameters for those actions

modifyLiquiditiesWithoutLock(bytes,bytes.details: This must be called by a contract that has already locked the vault

params.params: the parameters to provide for the actions

returns._subscriber: the address of the subscriber, if not set, it returns address(0)
returns.feeGrowthInside0LastX128: the fee growth count of token0 since last time updated
returns.feeGrowthInside1LastX128: the fee growth count of token1 since last time updated
returns.poolKey: the pool key of the position
returns.tickLower: the lower tick of the position
returns.tickUpper: the upper tick of the position

modifyLiquidities(bytes,uint256).notice: Unlocks Vault and batches actions for modifying liquidity

modifyLiquiditiesWithoutLock(bytes,bytes.notice: Batches actions for modifying liquidity without getting a lock from vault

nextTokenId().notice: Used to get the ID that will be used for the next minted liquidity position

positions(uint256).notice: Get the detailed information for a specified position
